messages:
alex: Heads-up — macos-smoke CI started failing after the darwin-sdk image update (rolled last night). Getting missing modulemap/headers for SDL2 and a handful of objc++ link errors. Job: https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/eng-infra/builds/98765 :grimacing:

ci-bot: Build failed: macos-smoke (matrix 3/5). Failing target: //third_party/sdl2:wrapper. Log: https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/98765

maria: thanks. can you paste the top of the link error? quick grep maybe?

alex: paste logs snippet:
```
ld: framework not found SDL2
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
/Users/runner/work/redwood/third_party/sdl2/wrapper.mm:10:10: fatal error: 'SDL.h' file not found
#include <SDL.h>
         ^~~~~~~
```

jin: hmm — we changed the darwin SDK path in the image: CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT now points to /Applications/Xcode_14.xcframework/.. which may flip header search order. Are these headers coming from a vendored modulemap or system framework?

alex: vendored. under third_party/sdl2/apple/SDL2.framework/Headers + a module.modulemap. worked fine before the image bump.

sanjay: could be the framework search path being skipped in our cmake config. Any change in `-F` flags in the compile command?

alex: compile line shows no `-Fthird_party/sdl2/apple`. weirdly the previous image injected a `-F` via environment, new image doesn't.

maria: ok can someone rerun the macos-smoke job with `EXPORT_EXTRA_FLAGS="-F$(pwd)/third_party/sdl2/apple"` to confirm? or alternatively we can bisect the infra image.

oncall-bot: @maria requested rerun for build 98765. Rerun queued.

alex: rerun failed same error. so it's not transient.

maria: I'd like to bisect the darwin image roll. alex — can you narrow down earliest good image sha? CI history shows last green at `darwin-image@sha256:aa11...` and first red at `darwin-image@sha256:bb22...`.

jin: I can take a quick bisect. plan:
- checkout infra-images repo
- run `git bisect start bb22 aa11 -- darwin`
- run the smoke job via local runner script (`./tools/local-smoke.sh --image sha`).
Anyone with permissions to kick image builds?

sanjay: I can build images. but let's avoid full image builds if we can reproduce locally by setting `SDKROOT` in the runner.

alex: local reproducer:
```
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work -e SDKROOT=/Applications/Xcode_14.xcframework/ -w /work ci-runner:darwin sh -c "cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build --target third_party_sdl2_wrapper"
```
When SDKROOT points to 14 it fails, with previous SDKROOT it passed.

maria: sounds like config expects older SDK layout. Immediate mitigation: add explicit `target_include_directories(third_party_sdl2 PUBLIC ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/sdl2/apple/SDL2.framework/Headers)` in CMakeLists. Not ideal but quick patch.

alex: filed PR: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/5421 — small include-path add. pinging @platform-owners for image change follow-up.

jin: I'll continue bisect and post the exact change that flipped header search. if it's just missing `-F`, we can add a smoke test that validates framework search flags in compile commands.

sanjay: agree. also add a CI gate that compares `SDKROOT` layout vs expectations.

maria: thx all. assign owners: alex (repro + PR), jin (bisect), sanjay (image perms + gating), i'll watch the PR. ping me once bisect gives commit.

alex: thanks :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build passed: macos-smoke (rerun with ENV patch) — 20m later.

oncall-bot: Notifying #eng-infra of status changes.
